role: CI gate (ci.yml thread-sanitizer job when inputs.scope != 'gates'; make thread-sanitizer, a prerequisite of make ci) that first proves a planted race (ThreadSanitizerCanaryTests with EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1) is reported and fails the run, then runs the EmuquTests unit target under Thread Sanitizer, serially and with halt_on_error=1, and fails on any TSan warning, any test failure, or a run in which no test case executed.
state: file:$TMPDIR/tsan.XXXXXX log and tsan-canary.XXXXXX log (temp, removed on EXIT)
mem:heartbeat (pid of the progress subshell, empty when none is running)
env:TEST_RUNNER_TSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 and TEST_RUNNER_EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1 (passed to xcodebuild, which hands them to the test host without the prefix)
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh and lib/xcodebuild.sh (no cd to repo root; relies on cwd). DESTINATION defaults to select_simulator_destination.sh output. gate_mktemp log (exit on failure); EXIT trap runs stop_heartbeat and removes both logs; gate_mktemp canary log (exit on failure). Canary: run_sanitized into the canary log with -only-testing EmuquTests/ThreadSanitizerCanaryTests and TEST_RUNNER_EMUQU_TSAN_CANARY=1 (set +e); gate_require_nonempty on it; unless it holds a 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer' line AND xcodebuild exited non-zero, prints both facts and the last 40 log lines and exits 1 (the setup cannot see races). Then starts a background heartbeat subshell (stderr discarded) that every 60 s prints the minutes elapsed and the count of "' passed" lines so far, runs run_sanitized into the log for EmuquTests (set +e), stop_heartbeat, prints the minutes taken. gate_require_nonempty on the log (empty -> exit 70). Counts 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer' lines, and test CASE results only: lines matching `Test [Cc]ase '<name>' passed` / `... failed` (`Test Suite` lines are not counted). races>0 -> prints 20 lines after each warning, exit 1. status != 0: if failed>0 prints the first 20 `' failed` lines; else greps build-error markers (both greps `|| true`) and tails 40 log lines; exits with xcodebuild's status. status 0 with zero passed test cases -> prints an error and the last 40 log lines, exit 1. Else appends the race and passed-test counts to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set. verify_gates_fail.sh runs it against a stand-in xcodebuild.

units.does: Stops the progress subshell: does nothing when heartbeat is empty; otherwise kills the subshell's children (its pending sleep) with pkill -P, kills the subshell, waits for it, and clears heartbeat. Every step ignores failure.
units.entry: Called after xcodebuild returns and from the EXIT trap.

units.does: One instrumented `xcodebuild test` run: `env TEST_RUNNER_TSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1 <extra NAME=value args> xcodebuild test "$XCODEBUILD_PINNED" -project -scheme -destination -derivedDataPath -enableThreadSanitizer YES -parallel-testing-enabled NO -only-testing:<selector>`, stdout and stderr into <log>; returns xcodebuild's status.
units.entry: Called twice from the script body: the canary run and the suite run.
